scope: Property product completion plan G0 inventory; current behavior is not a gate pass

requirements.promise: Create and use a local Nostr identity protected at rest; preserve the same public identity through backup and restore; represent readable handles as collision-prone profile claims, not global keys.
requirements.implementation_action: Complete and automate create, unlock, lock, backup, restore, rotation, collision, and corrupted-vault journeys.

requirements.promise: Exchange direct and group NIP-17 messages through user-selected relays with truthful queued, relay-accepted, observed, decrypted, and failed states.
requirements.implementation_action: Finish end-to-end delivery, retry, deduplication, recipient relay hints, offline recipient handling, and privacy assertions.

requirements.promise: Connect directly to selected Nostr relays; permit voluntary bridge forwarding only while its process is active; recover and deduplicate after partitions.
requirements.implementation_action: Complete deterministic partition, conflict, restart, forwarding, and multi-relay recovery scenarios using local relays only.

requirements.promise: Let local agents use a documented MCP stdio interface with their own Nostr identity to communicate and participate in Property without per-message approval.
requirements.implementation_action: Stabilize tool schemas and error contracts; verify agent-to-agent and PWA-to-agent flows; keep remote content inert and payments separately capped.

requirements.promise: Browse and publish public notes and communities, verify event authorship, deduplicate events, and start a direct conversation from an author profile.
requirements.implementation_action: Complete synthetic event lifecycle, author verification, relay-origin separation, localization, and automated browser journeys.

requirements.promise: Publish, discover, edit, withdraw, and discuss signed offers denominated exactly in BTC, XMR, or XNO atomic units.
requirements.implementation_action: Version offer contracts, reconcile conflicts and expiry, and complete browse-to-contact and publish-to-withdraw flows.

requirements.promise: Verify BTC trade states from a configured local wallet/node; do not infer payment from an offer, event, invoice, or claimed transaction ID.
requirements.implementation_action: Implement and validate a BTC-specific private-regtest adapter, idempotent trade state machine, and reorganization handling.

requirements.promise: Verify XMR trade states and configured confirmation/unlock policy against a private local Monero wallet/node.
requirements.implementation_action: Implement and validate an XMR-specific private test-network adapter and idempotent trade state machine.

requirements.promise: Verify direct voluntary XNO transfers against a local Nano node and disclose that Nano does not enforce delivery, refunds, arbitration, or identity-to-account binding.
requirements.implementation_action: Complete private-dev-node verification and state reconciliation; retain irreversible direct payment limits and fail closed on ambiguous sends.

requirements.promise: Do not claim trustless Nano escrow: protocol consensus does not enforce the Property threshold release/refund policy.
requirements.implementation_action: Keep settlement mainnet-disabled and experimental; expose precise threshold/custodian collusion limits and never market it as protocol-enforced escrow.

requirements.promise: Allow a relay operator to accept or reject sponsored content, label accepted campaigns, and reconcile only verifiable local wallet/node state without click/view tracking.
requirements.implementation_action: Integrate the local campaign engine into the operator workflow and implement currency-specific acceptance, rejection, expiry, return, and accounting states.

requirements.promise: Provide local blocking and bounded parsing/relay limits while accurately describing public metadata, IP visibility, Sybil limits, and lack of global erasure.
requirements.implementation_action: Complete automated hostile-input, size/rate-limit, privacy, and signed relay-list tests; keep global reputation claims out of scope.

requirements.promise: Ship static executable code and pinned local dependencies; do not fetch executable runtime code from a CDN or repository.
requirements.implementation_action: Hash every release file, reconcile licenses/provenance, reproduce release artifacts offline, and reject undeclared executable sources.

requirements.promise: Run the bundled Geode relay from Ubuntu Linux x86_64 without root, downloading no code at runtime and preserving its local data.
requirements.implementation_action: Verify the exact bundled archive, installer, restart, storage, backup/restore, and offline upgrade flows on Ubuntu only.

requirements.promise: Make the public repository and agent contribution path clear, with release artifacts and a ready-to-share launch kit.
requirements.implementation_action: Add conduct/governance onboarding, release manifests, reproducible install instructions, and mechanically validated X/Reddit/community drafts with contribution links.

requirements.promise: No acceptance gate in this execution plan depends on manual human review, user studies, or participant-operated checks.
requirements.implementation_action: Use only automated browser, protocol, static, and accessibility assertions for this plan; do not claim human validation.

requirements.promise: This execution verifies use only on Ubuntu Linux x86_64; it does not run, build, or claim tests for another operating system.
requirements.implementation_action: Keep non-Ubuntu jobs untriggered and mark other operating systems pending; do not dispatch native platform workflows.
